protocol.reset_timing: Between observations only; first observation starts from the same fresh dynamics in every arm.
protocol.hypothesis: Gate dropout may depend on carried neural dynamics rather than learned synaptic memory. Compare full dynamics reset, visual-filter reset and intrinsic-adaptation reset against both exact carried-state controls using the same three historical images.
protocol.interpretation: Post hoc mechanism experiment. Full retained graph and fixed decoder. All eight conditions reported; no account, P&L, policy selection, or live deployment. Resetting dynamics is a controlled intervention, not a claim of biological recovery or profitable learning.
